candidate_rule: two non-promoted candidates per record: verified official fact or deterministic supplier-group metric, plus explicit scope guard

scope_guards.monthly_snapshot: The June and July 2026 BDUK values are rounded management-information figures limited to initial contract scope, with variable ingestion lag; they do not establish exact-address completion, current availability, orderability or contractual milestone compliance.
scope_guards.supplier_metric: Supplier totals, shares, medians and rankings are deterministic calculations over the displayed rounded July table. They are not official statistics, supplier performance verdicts, parcel backlogs, forecasts or exact-address delivery claims.
scope_guards.connected_scope: Connected Nations figures are national or regional availability estimates using stated methodologies and reference dates; they do not prove service availability, performance or orderability at a particular address.
scope_guards.map_scope: Map Your Mobile combines predictive and crowdsourced information. Results are indicative, can vary with environment and time, and do not guarantee coverage or service quality at a specific point.
scope_guards.switch_scope: 2G and 3G transition guidance describes announced plans and general consumer effects; device compatibility, timing and required action depend on the provider, network, device and service.
